description: Fetch a single product by id, including description, categories, tags, attributes, and every variation's own price and stock. Scope: `woo:products:read`. For a variable product, the variation list is usually the real answer to "is this in stock?".

site.description: Site alias to target (e.g. "guns2ammo"). Omit when only one site is configured.

name: bridgistic_woo_get_product
title: Get one WooCommerce product
